2610.02480.title: MEA: A Reward-Driven Multi-Agent System for Faithful Model Explanations
2610.02480.paper_summary: Recent years have seen the employment of a plethora of machine learning (ML) models in high-stakes domains, but they remain largely opaque to the practitioners who act on their predictions. While post-hoc explanation methods offer a lens into this model behavior, wielding them effectively demands expertise most domain experts lack: navigating high-dimensional outputs, selecting the best explanations, and synthesizing evidence across disparate tools. To this end, we present MEA, a multi-agent framework that removes the explanation knowledge barrier entirely: a Proposer agent selects and configures explanation tools based on the question and modality, while an Actor agent is optimized end-to-end against faithfulness, transforming the outputs into natural language explanations grounded in model behavior across tabular, text, and vision modalities. Further, we introduce diverse question types spanning feature attribution, counterfactual reasoning, and spurious feature detection, each paired with a perturbation-based faithfulness metric. We find that frontier LLMs systematically produce unfaithful explanations. By optimizing against faithfulness rewards augmented with a modality-adaptive penalty, MEA consistently outperforms post hoc explainers, agentic, and closed-source baselines across six datasets, with reward-driven optimization yielding faithfulness gains of +28% (tabular), +21% (text), and +34% (vision) over the untrained backbone. More broadly, our findings suggest that AI agents themselves can serve as a scalable, adaptable interface to ML explainability, opening a path toward natural-language explainability that generalizes beyond the fixed, single-purpose tools that have long defined the field.
2610.02480.paper_summary_zh: 近年來，在高風險領域中使用了大量的機器學習（ML）模型，但對於根據其預測行動的從業者來說，這些模型仍然在很大程度上是模糊不清的。雖然事後解釋方法提供了了解這些模型行為的視角，但有效地運用這些方法需要大多數領域專家所缺乏的專業知識：導航高維輸出、選擇最佳解釋以及在不同工具之間綜合證據。為此，我們提出了MEA，一個完全消除解釋知識障礙的多代理框架：一個提議者代理根據問題和模式選擇和配置解釋工具，而一個行動者代理則針對真實性進行端到端的優化，將輸出轉換為基於模型行為的自然語言解釋，涵蓋表格、文本和視覺模式。此外，我們介紹了多樣的問題類型，涵蓋特徵歸因、反事實推理和虛假特徵檢測，每種問題類型都配有基於擾動的真實性度量。我們發現，前沿的LLM系統性地產生不真實的解釋。通過針對增強了模式自適應懲罰的真實性獎勵進行優化，MEA在六個數據集上始終超越事後解釋者、代理和封閉源基準，獎勵驅動的優化在未訓練的骨幹上實現了+28%（表格）、+21%（文本）和+34%（視覺）的真實性增益。更廣泛地說，我們的研究結果表明，AI代理本身可以作為可擴展的、可適應的ML可解釋性接口，為自然語言可解釋性開辟了一條通向超越長期定義該領域的固定單一用途工具的道路。
